name: Krol'dok Moulding
summary: A moulding found near Rog'mar appears to be part of a key. Someone in the settlement may know what it opens.

sections.title: A Curious Mould
sections.body: You have a moulding that seems made for a key. In Rog'mar, someone may know what the piece is for. If it came from the stronghold, it may be important.

faq.answer: The moulding appears to be for a key.
Someone in Rog'mar may know about the mould.
If the moulding is from the stronghold, it must be important.
